skill.name: performance
skill.description: Comprehensive performance specialist for profiling applications, finding bottlenecks, planning authorized load tests, optimizing React and frontend performance, and documenting practical fixes.
skill.summary: Analyze, test, and improve application performance across backend, frontend, database, and React systems.
skill.author: Joseph OBrien

security_audit.summary: The static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown examples, placeholder URLs, React lazy-loading samples, and ordinary performance wording. No evidence of malware, prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or hidden command execution was found. The main residual risk is dual-use load testing guidance that should require authorization before execution.

remediation.issue: Load and stress test guidance lacks an explicit authorization requirement.
remediation.suggestion: Add a visible instruction to confirm ownership or written permission before generating or running high-volume tests.

remediation.issue: Executable load test examples use placeholder external targets.
remediation.suggestion: Use variables such as AUTHORIZED_BASE_URL and tell users to replace them only with approved test targets.

content.value_statement: Slow applications lose users and hide costly infrastructure issues. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code profile bottlenecks, plan load tests, and document practical fixes.
actual_capabilities: Identifies bottlenecks across CPU, memory, network, database, frontend, and React rendering paths.
Creates load testing plans using k6, Artillery, JMeter, and Locust patterns.
Builds performance reports with latency percentiles, throughput, error rate, and resource metrics.
Recommends database query fixes, indexing improvements, and N+1 query reductions.
Suggests React memoization, lazy loading, code splitting, and bundle reduction tactics.
Defines monitoring and alerting metrics for performance degradation and SLA tracking.
limitations: It does not replace production profiling tools or real monitoring data.
Load tests must target only systems you own or have permission to test.
Recommendations need verification with measurements before production rollout.
Framework guidance is strongest for Node.js, React, databases, APIs, and web frontend systems.

use_cases.title: Plan Capacity Before Launch
use_cases.description: Create a measured load profile, expected traffic targets, and scaling recommendations before a release.

use_cases.title: Improve Core Web Vitals
use_cases.description: Find frontend bottlenecks, reduce bundle size, and prioritize LCP, FID, and CLS improvements.

use_cases.title: Fix Slow API Endpoints
use_cases.description: Analyze latency metrics, detect query issues, and document backend optimization steps.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Bottlenecks
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this application for obvious performance bottlenecks. Start with latency, throughput, memory, CPU, database queries, and frontend assets.

prompt_templates.title: Improve React Rendering
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React feature for unnecessary renders, expensive computations, bundle size issues, and Core Web Vitals risks. Recommend measurable fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Design Authorized Load Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a load test plan for an authorized staging API. Include traffic phases, success thresholds, monitored metrics, and rollback criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Build Remediation Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the available measurements to produce a prioritized performance remediation plan across application code, database, frontend, infrastructure, and monitoring.

output_examples.input: An API endpoint averages 2.3 seconds and slows further during peak traffic.
output: Summary: P95 latency is above target and worsens under load.
Likely cause: repeated database queries during each request.
Next steps: collect query traces, add a focused benchmark, and validate one query optimization at a time.

output_examples.input: A React dashboard feels slow after filters or chart updates.
output: Summary: Rendering work should be measured before applying memoization.
Likely cause: expensive chart calculations and repeated child component updates.
Next steps: profile the interaction, split heavy charts, and confirm improvements with Core Web Vitals.

output_examples.input: A team wants to test an authorized staging service before launch.
output: Summary: Use a staged load profile with clear stop conditions.
Suggested metrics: P95 latency, error rate, throughput, CPU, memory, and database saturation.
Next steps: confirm authorization, run a small baseline, then increase traffic in controlled phases.

best_practices: Start with baseline measurements and define P95, throughput, and error targets before changing code.
Change one bottleneck at a time, then measure the result with the same workload.
Use authorized staging or owned production traffic patterns for load testing.
anti_patterns: Do not run stress tests against third-party systems or shared services without written permission.
Do not optimize based on guesses when profiling data is available.
Do not add memoization, caching, or indexes without checking correctness and invalidation behavior.

faq.question: Can this skill run load tests?
faq.answer: It can help design and interpret load tests. Only run tests against systems you are authorized to test.

faq.question: Which applications does it support?
faq.answer: It supports web applications, APIs, databases, React apps, and general backend performance workflows.

faq.question: Does it optimize React performance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers memoization, lazy loading, code splitting, bundle reduction, and Core Web Vitals improvements.

faq.question: Can it diagnose database performance?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review slow queries, missing indexes, N+1 query patterns, and connection pool issues.

faq.question: Does it require live monitoring data?
faq.answer: No, but real metrics make the recommendations more accurate and easier to verify.

faq.question: How should I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Open the project, provide measured symptoms, and ask for a focused performance audit or remediation plan.
